svg.title: System 1632: real orbit and the trained network's prediction
svg.desc: The real x-y orbit of the three bodies beside the trained network's predicted tracks and each body's time-mean position, and the network's error against time beside the error of guessing each body's average position and the Tier-1 limit.
svg.text: System 1632: real orbit and the trained network's prediction (official state, re-derived on the CPU in float64)
Official state (polish), re-derived from the committed weights. Nothing is trained.

g.text: Panel A: real orbit and network prediction (x-y)

the cross marks each body's time mean
error (largest of the body and inner-pair errors)
